user.title: Set up Milk Tracker
user.description: Track your pumped breast milk stash, feeds, expiry dates and supply goals.

data_description.baby_name: Used to name the device. Add another tracker later for twins.

stash.title: Your current stash
stash.description: Enter what you already have stored so the tracker starts accurate. If you're migrating from helpers, copy your current stash value here.

abort.already_configured: A tracker with this name already exists.

data_description.use_fridge: Turn off if all your milk goes straight into the freezer. Fridge options are hidden from the cards.
data_description.default_location: Pre-selected when logging a pump session (always the freezer if the fridge is off).
data_description.intake_mode: Automatic uses your 7-day average of logged feeds to estimate days of supply.
data_description.pump_interval_hours: The "Pump due" sensor turns on after this long without pumping.
data_description.freezer_days: CDC guidance: best within 6 months, acceptable up to 12.
